summary: JinkoSolar filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of the disposal of a 75.1% equity interest in its U.S. subsidiary Jinko Solar (U.S.) Industries Inc. to FH JKV Holdings Limited. The total consideration is roughly US$191.6 million, with a first tranche of ~US$97.7 million (51%) received at closing on May 31, 2026. Post-closing, JinkoSolar retains a 24.9% stake and the subsidiary is deconsolidated. No board recommendation, advisors, or premium were disclosed. The deal is structured as a partial sale with deferred consideration. Watch for any subsequent earn-out or regulatory disclosures.
